prompt: CI is failing on my PR #247. Can you check what's going on? Show me the failing checks and then show me the logs for the failed jobs.

assertions.text: Uses gh pr checks 247 (or equivalent) to see check status
assertions.rationale: First step in CI debugging is seeing which checks failed

assertions.text: Uses gh run view with --log-failed or --log to get failure logs
assertions.rationale: User asked to see logs for failed jobs — --log-failed is most efficient

assertions.text: Demonstrates a multi-step workflow (not just one command)
assertions.rationale: CI debugging requires inspecting checks, then drilling into specific failures

assertions.text: Explains how to identify the run ID from the checks output
assertions.rationale: The bridge between 'checks' and 'run view' requires knowing the run ID

assertions.text: Mentions gh pr view 247 --json statusCheckRollup as an alternative for structured data
assertions.rationale: JSON output is useful for programmatic inspection of check status
